title: Befer AI — Lead & Appointment Management System
keyResult: Validated 100% of geospatial service area boundaries and embeddable iframe booking flows

overview.product: Befer AI is an AI-powered CRM and booking platform enabling service businesses to embed real-time booking widgets into third-party websites, automate customer appointments, manage subscription tiers, and dispatch automated dialer calls.
overview.role: Associate SQA Engineer responsible for booking engine test suites, iframe security checks, and service area boundary verification.

challenge: Service area zip-code filtering frequently allowed out-of-zone customer bookings due to floating point rounding in geospatial distance queries. Cross-domain iframe widgets also faced message passing race conditions on mobile Safari.

testStrategy.scope: Iframe embed scripts, appointment slot locking, calendar sync, service radius boundary checks, and outbound dialer queues.
environments: Staging (iOS Safari, Android Chrome, macOS Chrome)

sampleTestCases.title: Service Area Radius Boundary Value Check (25.0km Limit)
sampleTestCases.steps: Input customer address at 24.9km, 25.0km (exact threshold), and 25.1km from business headquarters.
sampleTestCases.expected: 24.9km and 25.0km are accepted; 25.1km displays graceful 'Outside service zone' validation.
sampleTestCases.actual: Exact boundary validated; out-of-zone bookings blocked.

sampleTestCases.title: Cross-Origin Iframe Booking Slot Lock
sampleTestCases.steps: Embed booking widget in mock client origin; select 10:00 AM slot and verify database lock status.
sampleTestCases.expected: Slot locks for 10 minutes (`201 Created`); duplicate browser session cannot select same slot.
sampleTestCases.actual: Lock persists; second user receives slot unavailable notice.

sampleBug.steps:
1. Embed booking widget into HTTPS client site.
2. Submit appointment on iPhone Safari.
3. Observe parent window height postMessage.
sampleBug.expected: Iframe dynamically resizes to confirmation screen height.
sampleBug.actual: Iframe height clipped at 300px, cutting off confirm button on mobile Safari.
sampleBug.impact: Prevented mobile customers from completing booking confirmation. Fixed before production deployment.

results.regressionTimeSaved: Cut booking regression verification from 8 hours to 1.5 hours
results.releaseQuality: Zero customer complaints regarding out-of-area booking dispatch

learnings: Applying formal Boundary Value Analysis on mathematical calculations (such as geospatial radii) prevents silent business logic defects that simple exploratory testing easily misses.
